item.title: github: Budget limit increased to 40,000 budgets per account
item.description:
GitHub Enterprise Cloud accounts can now have up to 40,000 budgets, increased from the previous limit of 10,000. This is intended for accounts managing budgets across many users or cost centers.

  • Source: GitHub
